mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion, as measured by rising new single-family home starts (HOUST), consumer confidence and disposable income growth accelerate, leading to stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 12mo MA, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 12mo MA, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) indicates a policy response to inflation that is insufficient to curb price pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged inflation and eventual rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock, as indicated by a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month low, manufacturing output contraction leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 6mo low, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
